message.bhop250.no_cloth_config: BHOP250: install Cloth Config for the in-game editor, or edit %s
config.bhop250.title: BHOP250
config.bhop250.movement.help: Air-strafe: in the air, let go of W, hold A (or D) and turn your mouse smoothly the same way. Chain left/right strafes between hops. Hold jump to bunny hop.
config.bhop250.option.enabled.tooltip:
Replace vanilla walking/jumping physics with Source-engine air-strafing and bunny hopping.
Creative flight, swimming, elytra, ladders and vehicles always use vanilla physics.
config.bhop250.option.airAccelerate.tool:
sv_airaccelerate. How sharply you can redirect in the air.
CS:GO 12, surf 150, bhop servers 1000.
High values are forgiving when strafing but stop you instantly if you hold a key against your motion.
config.bhop250.option.airSpeedCap.toolti:
sv_air_max_wishspeed. The main control for how much speed each strafe adds.
A perfect strafe tick adds cap² to speed².
Source uses 30 at 64-100 tick; Minecraft runs at 20 ticks, so ~70-80 feels similar.
config.bhop250.option.groundFriction.too:
sv_friction. Speed lost for every tick on the ground outside the perfect-hop window.
CS:GO 5.2, surf 4. 0 = never slow down.
config.bhop250.option.perfectHopWindowTi:
Ground ticks after landing that skip friction, so a jump pressed slightly late keeps all your speed.
0 = you must jump on the exact landing tick (1 tick = 50 ms).
config.bhop250.option.hopSpeedLossPercen: Extra penalty: percent of horizontal speed lost on every hop. Never takes you below normal ground speed.
config.bhop250.option.autoBhop.tooltip: Holding jump re-jumps on the exact tick you land (removes vanilla's 10-tick jump cooldown).
config.bhop250.option.groundAccelerate.t: sv_accelerate. How quickly you reach full speed on the ground. CS:GO 5.5, surf/bhop servers 10.
config.bhop250.option.stopSpeed.tooltip: sv_stopspeed. Below this speed, friction acts as if you were moving at this speed, so you stop crisply.
config.bhop250.option.baseGroundSpeed.to:
Ground speed at vanilla walking speed. Sprinting is 1.3x, Speed/Slowness scale it too.
250 matches vanilla Minecraft (4.317 blocks/s).
config.bhop250.option.maxSpeed.tooltip: sv_maxvelocity. Hard cap on horizontal speed. 2000 UPS is about 34.5 blocks/s.
config.bhop250.option.sprintJumpBoost.to: Keep vanilla's extra forward push on every sprint jump. Off = pure Source (speed only comes from strafing).
config.bhop250.option.hudEnabled.tooltip: Show horizontal speed in units per second (UPS).
config.bhop250.option.hudAnchor.tooltip: Screen corner/edge to anchor the speedometer to.
config.bhop250.option.hudOffsetX.tooltip: Pixels inwards from the anchored side (GUI-scaled).
config.bhop250.option.hudOffsetY.tooltip: Pixels inwards from the anchored side (GUI-scaled).
config.bhop250.option.hudShowUnits.toolt: Append the UPS suffix to the number.
config.bhop250.option.hudAvoidEffectIcon: In the top-right corner, move down below the potion-effect icons when they're showing.
config.bhop250.option.hudBaselineSpeed.t: At or below this speed the text stays white. Vanilla sprinting is 325 UPS.
config.bhop250.option.hudColorSensitivit: Smoothed UPS change per tick needed to turn green (gaining) or red (losing). Lower = more reactive.
